blockingIssues.description: The vector retriever still orders equal-distance candidates only by distance before its inner LIMIT, so the top-N subset and downstream RRF ranking can still drift across runs.

appliedUpdates.description: Documented that vector retriever tie ordering must be stabilized before the inner LIMIT; adding a secondary sort after LIMIT is too late for equal-distance candidates.

rejectedObservations.observation: The search-worker skill's tests-first guidance was deviated from during the feature review.
rejectedObservations.reason: Not systemic; this was a justified one-off repro-first deviation for a pure chunker regression and does not warrant an AGENTS or skill update.
